This Little-Known Waze Workaround Solved My Biggest Android Auto Navigation Issues

2026-07-06 Jade Bryan, Android Police Waze, Android Auto, navigation glitches, app crash, unresponsive screen, app reinstall, Google Maps alternative, crowdsourced navigation, troubleshooting, connected car
Read the source article

Quick summary

A simple uninstall-and-reinstall of Waze proved to be the most effective fix for persistent Android Auto glitches including frozen screens, unresponsive touch inputs, and mid-drive crashes — problems that affect both wired and wireless connections across multiple devices and car models.

Key takeaways

  • Waze on Android Auto suffers from recurring glitches: app crashes, unresponsive touch inputs, and screen freezes mid-drive
  • These issues affect both wired and wireless Android Auto connections across different phone models (Samsung, Pixel) and car brands (Toyota)
  • Force-closing Waze on the phone also closes it on Android Auto, often resolving dashboard unresponsiveness
  • The most effective permanent fix found was completely uninstalling and reinstalling Waze, then rebooting the device
  • Another workaround: remove Waze from Android Auto's default startup apps and launch it manually each drive to bypass boot-up bottlenecks
  • Clearing app cache was less effective than a clean reinstall
  • The author argues Google prioritizes Google Maps polish over Waze stability, treating Waze as a secondary app
